title: kv-cache-eviction-spillover-defrag-heuristics-v3
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: reduce KV-cache OOMs and suboptimal eviction behavior under high-concurrency, long-tail workloads by improving memory accounting for fragmentation, smarter paging/spillover thresholds, and an opportunistic background defragmentation job. This PR consolidates previous heuristics (v1/v2) and includes a new eviction priority that combines LRU score, entry size, estimated fragmentation risk, and affinity to active request shards. Approach: 1) Add precise per-arena free-run accounting to track external/internal fragmentation and expose 'frag_score' for each arena. 2) Introduce page-level spillover thresholds: soft_limit (start paging) and hard_limit (force eviction), with dynamic hysteresis tuned by observed tail-latency and active sequence-length percentiles. 3) Implement opportunistic defrag worker that coalesces small free blocks into larger contiguous pages during low-util windows; worker is rate-limited and bounded by throttles per-GPU to avoid latency interference. 4) Eviction selector now computes a composite eviction_score = w1*age_norm + w2*size_norm + w3*frag_risk - w4*active_affinity where weights are runtime-configurable and can be rolled out via feature flags. 5) Add a fast-path for short-lived KV entries (typical chat-turn caches) to avoid premature promotion into defrag-sensitive arenas. Compatibility and rollout: changes are behind a config flag (kv.eviction.v3.enabled) and default to off. Rollout plan: enable v3 for internal perf-canary cluster (5% of traffic) for 48h, monitor OOMs, tail-latency, and per-gpu page-faults; then progressive ramp to dedicated pools with automatic rollback if OOMs or 99.9th latency degrade >5%. Tests and validation: unit tests for arena accounting and eviction score calculation, integration tests exercising paging/spillover under synthetic sequence-length distributions, and a stress test harness that replays production trace samples (5M requests) with varying memory pressure. Canary results: on canary we observed ~12% reduction in KV-cache evictions, ~18% reduction in p99 token generation latency under peak load, and 7% improvement in sustained throughput due to fewer forced reloads from spillover. CI notes: an initial flaky test related to timing in the defrag worker required adding deterministic clocks to the unit test; CI was re-run and passed. Related work: picks up the heuristics from ENG-2145 and addresses production regressions called out in ENG-2320. Implementation notes: adds ~1.3k LOC (C++ runtime) and small TS config surface in console; changes include new metrics: kv.frag_score, kv.evictions_by_reason, kv.defrag_cycles, and kv.page_spill_count. Observability and alerts: added an alert kv_high_spillover (fires if kv.page_spill_count rate > 5/min sustained for >10m) and dashboard panels for frag_score distribution. Backwards compatibility: on flag off behavior is identical to v2. Migration: no on-disk format changes. Performance risk mitigations: defrag worker has a global throttle and the eviction algorithm early-exits to avoid expensive scans when under tight latency SLOs.

Introduce soft/hard page spillover thresholds and config
Eviction selector: composite eviction_score and weights
Unit+integration tests for defrag and spillover
Add console flags and rollout config
Fix flaky defrag unit test by injecting deterministic clock
Perf canary harness and metric hooks
review_comments: Liam O'Connor: Can we avoid an O(N) scan on large arenas in the eviction selector? Suggested adding a sampled bloom filter for fragmentation hotspots.
Asha Patel: Added sampling optimization in eviction_selector and moved hotspot detector to background sampler (see commit 'Eviction selector: composite eviction_score and weights').
Sofia Martinez: Verified metrics and added dashboard panels; asked for alert thresholds - added kv_high_spillover alert as requested.
Daniel Wu: Noted a potential latency regression on 8k sequence-length tails; added a canary-specific throttle to defrag worker to limit interference.
Code owner approvals: Liam O'Connor approved, Sofia Martinez approved, Daniel Wu approved.
release_notes:
- Improved KV-cache memory management: fragmentation accounting, smarter spillover thresholds, and opportunistic defragmentation
- Composite eviction policy combining recency, size, and fragmentation risk
- New metrics (kv.frag_score, kv.defrag_cycles, kv.page_spill_count) and alert kv_high_spillover
- Default rollout behind feature flag (kv.eviction.v3.enabled).
